prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Ghanaian woman, THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s silver fox goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, silver-white hair in a sleek high ponytail — full body stained glass covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles — this is solid thick glass fused directly to her form, made of hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, densely packed edge to edge in an irregular cathedral-window mosaic, the panes small and numerous across her whole body, each tiny pane curving to follow her body's true shape with real physical thickness, dark lead-line seams webbing between every one of the hundreds of panes, each seam standing in a small raised ridge casting its own shadow. BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET and VIVID CYAN panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, no two adjacent panes quite the same shade, bright light passing through each tiny pane individually with sharp refraction glints, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A faint streak of soot crosses her cheekbone, and a little grime darkens her fingertips and the soles of her bare feet. Her expression is a quiet, serious expression. Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a long thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, that runs back along her sides to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball dragging on the flagstones behind her, the chains pulled taut by its weight so her arms are drawn back. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links. Pose: walking slowly, her body turned in profile to the camera and her face turned toward the camera, leaning forward against the pull with her arms drawn back along her sides to the chains, the iron ball dragging on the flagstones behind her, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long stiletto nails to match.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
